crossRefs.note: My days are past. My plans are broken off, as are the thoughts of my heart.
God said to him in the dream, “Yes, I know that in the integrity of your heart you have done this, and I also withheld…
Yahweh of Armies has planned it, to stain the pride of all glory, to bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.
Therefore behold, I will hedge up your way with thorns, and I will build a wall against her, that she can’t find her…
While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, “Have nothing to do with that righteous man…
and asked for letters from him to the synagogues of Damascus, that if he found any who were of the Way, whether men or…
who fed you in the wilderness with manna, which your fathers didn’t know, that he might humble you, and that he might…
But Hezekiah didn’t reciprocate appropriate to the benefit done for him, because his heart was lifted up. Therefore…
The lofty looks of man will be brought low, the arrogance of men will be bowed down, and Yahweh alone will be exalted…
The king spoke and said, “Is not this great Babylon, which I have built for the royal dwelling place, by the might of…
By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh…
Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.
